svg.aria-label: kvm1 bare-metal Ubuntu 26.04 host with libvirt, NFS, ansible, cockpit, hardware RAID, br0, and VM NFS clients
svg.text: Bare-metal Dell PowerEdge R660 - Ubuntu 26.04.1 LTS - sv-fwdev-1
kvm1 host | bare metal | Ubuntu 26.04.1 | 64 CPU | 499 GiB RAM | 100.113.58.224/24
Storage · SAS disks → RAID virtual disks → LVM volume groups
PERC H755 Front · SAS-12G · WriteBack · no hot spare
OS view: /dev/sda (GPT boot + OS) /dev/sdb (whole-disk LVM PV)
LVM extents 4 MiB | ubuntu-vg on sda3 | vg_pool on sdb
DOWN / unused - guests use br0 bridged networking
NFSv4.2 mounts from kvm1 + virtio NICs on br0
Each guest: 7 vCPU, 32 GiB RAM, virtio NIC on br0, disks on lv_libvirt, NFSv4.2 from 100.113.58.224
